channel.description: Updates for Device Performance Monitor — live memory, CPU, thread and frame-rate monitoring from Coursion.

item.title: Version 1.3.0
item.description: Startup timing, the Log viewer and Battery & thermal now cover iOS (simulator and physical devices) alongside Android; Startup timing lets you pick from installed apps; the log view renders parsed, color-coded rows; and every surface has a proper Home button.
